summary:
Quantum Orbits 
>> Earth System Trend Detective 
Is an interactive web-based platform developed to explore and understand changes in Earth's environmental systems. Our project addresses NASA's challenge by making complex Earth-observation data easier to access, visualize and analyze.

The initial prototype integrates NASA POWER climate data and Open-Meteo air-quality information, presenting temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind patterns, historical charts, annual averages and CSV exports through an interactive dashboard.

Our broader vision includes integrating additional NASA resources such as Giovanni, AppEEARS, MODIS and Hydrology Time Series to investigate vegetation health, soil moisture, monsoon patterns and atmospheric conditions.

The platform aims to help users identify environmental patterns, compare historical observations and understand relationships between different Earth-system variables.

This project is important because environmental changes affect agriculture, water resources, climate and ecosystems. By transforming scientific datasets into understandable visual insights, Quantum Orbits aims to make Earth science more accessible and support informed environmental awareness and research.
details:
Project Details: Quantum Orbits – Earth System Trend Detective

Earth System Trend Detective is a web-based platform designed to help users explore, visualize, and understand changes in Earth's environment using NASA Earth science datasets. It brings important environmental indicators such as temperature, precipitation, humidity, vegetation, soil moisture, air quality, and other climate-related variables into one interactive dashboard.

The platform works by using Earth observation data to present environmental trends through interactive charts, geographical maps, and visual indicators. Users can explore different locations, compare environmental variables, and identify patterns that may indicate climate and ecosystem changes.

Benefits and Intended Impact: The project makes complex scientific data easier to understand and accessible to students, researchers, educators, and the general public. It aims to improve environmental awareness, support data-driven decision-making, and encourage informed discussions about climate change and Earth's changing systems.

Tools and Technologies: We developed the platform using Google AI Studio, AI-assisted web development, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web-based mapping technology. NASA Earth science resources, including Giovanni, Hydrology Time Series, and AppEEARS, were considered for accessing and exploring environmental datasets.

Creativity and Innovation: The project's main innovation is bringing multiple Earth system indicators together in a unified, interactive platform instead of requiring users to explore separate scientific tools. Its combination of geographical visualization, trend analysis, and an accessible dashboard creates a more engaging way to explore environmental data.

Factors Considered: Our team considered data reliability, accessibility, ease of use, visualization clarity, geographical relevance, scientific accuracy, and the limitations of available datasets. We also considered future improvements such as additional NASA datasets, expanded historical coverage, and more advanced environmental trend analysis.

Our vision is to transform complex Earth science data into meaningful environmental insights that anyone can explore and understand.
